corrected_v9_note: Manuscript version 9 (24 September 2026) recomputes the paper with SPRAT 1.1.0: the complex band structure keeps physical roots only (the least-evanescent pair of earlier versions is a truncation artefact of the square plane-wave basis); fits and statistics use the records admitted by the validity criterion only; the analyte energy fraction is evaluated with the permittivity E_z sees, reconstructed from the geometry (the stored map is Meep's harmonic mean of the eigenvalues of the smoothed tensor); Q_abs = lambda_r / (2 k S). Section corrected_v9 lists every number new in version 9, superseded_v9 the statements of version 8 it corrects, both recomputed from the records. The dataset rows of corrected_v9 state that the strongest mode of 537 of the 741 admitted records, those of the preliminary sweep (n_cl = 6, resolution 20) at N_sep = 1 or r_d >= 0.13a, is a low-Q mode of the finite waveguide (436 of them in the dead zone r_d >= 0.14a), and that 204 admitted records hold a cavity mode; records.csv flags the former in the column waveguide_mode.

corrected_v10_note: Manuscript version 10 (24 September 2026) adds the transmission spectra with the guide continued into an 8a adiabatic absorber, every other run parameter as the 25a-cell spectrum of the same analyte index (raw_h14b.tar.gz of the record; section termination). The criterion fixed before those runs (D-22: factor = |q| in the 25a cell over |q| with the absorber, >= 3 supports and <= 1.5 refutes the attribution of the residual asymmetry to the guide ends, pass = supports at all seven indices) is not passed: the factor at n_a = 1.300 is 1.61, inconclusive. Its amendment A1, fixed at 15:46:39 (+03:00) before the first absorber cavity spectrum was written (15:53:07), grades the ratio at the five indices where |q| in the 25a cell exceeds 0.2 and is passed there (factors 8.95 to 213.41). Amendment A2 measures the cell factor G across the analyte sweep. Version 10 also states the share of the harmonic-inversion records admitted and holding a cavity mode (corrected_v10) and registers the fall of the quality factor of the 25a cell over the analyte sweep, 5.01, which section 3.6 printed without a row, updates the number of transmission spectra of the record to 14 and the absorption cap of the abstract to near 9200, and renames two quantities, the records of the systematic runs and the threshold-mask estimate of the analyte energy fraction (the registry of version 9 has their earlier names).
